review_type: author visual QA of generated artwork, not independent review

A.packaging_front_readability: large bread windows and prominent Japanese name labels; fine lettering is not guaranteed at 1:1

B.packaging_front_readability: large bread windows and simple label bands; SKU recognition relies on bread shape and color

limitations: Generated shelf vertices do not exactly match the guide: alpha>8 bounding extents differ by up to 9 px after whole-image normalization.
Anchor (285,303) is preserved as canonical metadata and comparison crosshair; exact geometric registration is not certified.
Croissants are stylized rounded laminated shapes rather than consistently pronounced crescents.
At high magnification a faint colored fringe and very low-alpha stray pixels remain in the generator originals; alpha is preserved without background stripping.
Corresponding canopy length estimates are manual, approximately 2px endpoint uncertainty; Hough medians are diagnostics, not proof of exact projection.
